description: Uploads an image (png, jpeg, gif or webp; no SVG) and returns a content-addressed URL to reference from page HTML. Pass `data` as base64 plus `contentType`.

data.description: Image bytes in base64 (without the data: URI prefix)

file_path.description: Local image file (relative to OUTBOX_FILES_DIR). Mutually exclusive with data

name: outbox_upload
title: Outbox: upload an image
